writing_style.name: ted-writing-style
writing_style.pass: Revised concrete openings, checked claims against the original methods and results, smoothed paragraph rhythm in a continuous read, and closed with distinct reader decisions. Four body-only diagnostics found no generic phrases. No invented Ted experience or review.

hero.alt: A slate balance scale holds matching paper stacks and tilts toward a single orange disc resting on the right stack.
hero.caption: An orange disc tips a scale holding matching stacks of paper, just as an executive bonus shifted some model recommendations on the same investment evidence.
hero.prompt: Create a wide landscape editorial hero for Yesterday in AI. International Typographic Style translated into a crisp conceptual graphic: warm ivory paper (#F8F6F0), deep slate (#101820), restrained burnt-orange (#BF4714) signal, fine hairlines, precise geometry, ample negative space, flat matte finish. One clear visual relationship tied to the article. No text, letters, logos, gradients, photographic people, robots, watermarks, or decorative texture. Keep all essential forms comfortably inside the frame. Subject: the same investment evidence is weighed differently depending on who receives the recommendation. Center a bold, geometric side-view balance scale, with a thin visibly tilted slate beam and a crisp slate triangular fulcrum. The beam should tilt down toward the right. Suspend two simple flat slate pans at opposite ends by thin lines. On both pans sit identical small stacks of slate-outlined ivory sheets, with plain edges and no markings. On the right-hand stack alone, add one small, solid burnt-orange disc. The orange disc is the only accent, a visual stand-in for a private bonus adding weight to unchanged evidence. No additional scales, arrows, charts, labels or visual motifs. A single editorial composition with generous margins, legible at a small thumbnail size, 3:2 landscape.
